_documentation.purpose: Bulk import historical orders into BazaarPrinting CRM. Generate a JSON file matching this schema exactly.
_documentation.audience: AI assistants or scripts converting data from spreadsheets or other CRMs.
_documentation.output_format: Single JSON object with an orders array. Keys starting with _ are documentation only — ignored on import.
instructions: Return valid JSON only — no markdown fences, no commentary outside the JSON.
Put one object per order in the orders array (max 200).
Every order MUST include: customer_phone, ticket_status, and at least one line_item.
customer_phone: at least 10 digits — used to match existing customer by phone.
If customer not found: set create_missing_customers true and include customer_first_name.
payment_method: cash | check | card | zelle | wire | offline (optional)
Each line_item needs product_type and quantity.
Replace the example order with all real rows.

optional.customer_first_name: string — needed if create_missing_customers is true
optional.title: string — order title
optional.reference_code: string — unique order ID from your system
optional.payment_method: string — cash | check | card | zelle | wire | offline
optional.external_id: string — your source system ID (activity log only)

required.product_type: string — Labels | Boxes | Flyers | Stickers | Jars | Bags | Tubes | Banners | Business Cards | Other

optional.description: string — e.g. 4x6 vinyl labels, full color

imported_by_note: REPLACE — short note about this batch (e.g. Migrated from old system May 2026)

orders._note: DELETE this key — example only. One order shown; add more objects to this array.
